name: weekly-battle-plan
description: A dark-mode drag-and-drop to-do list that shows one set of tasks two ways, by section or by day, with three-state checkboxes, overdue roll-over onto today, custom tags, a Done Dumpster, a weekly progress bar and a Stats view. One self-contained HTML file: open it straight from disk, or publish it as a private Claude artifact to sync your tasks across your devices.
